question: Which of my accounts had the most revenue last quarter, and who is the contact?
answer:
## Revenue Is Masked for Your Role — Here's What's Available

I confirmed this matches what I found in our conversation an hour ago: dollar revenue is intentionally hidden from account managers in this dataset. I re-ran the certified revenue rollup (`poc.sales.revenue_by_account`) for Q3 2026 (last quarter: Jul–Sep), scoped automatically to your accounts via row-level security — the `revenue` measure comes back `null` for every one of your 12 accounts, by design (account managers see order activity, not dollar revenue; that's reserved for finance analysts) [poc.sales.revenue_by_account](https://<workspace-host>/explore/data/poc/sales/revenue_by_account?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=<workspace-id>). I also checked the customer-reported `annual_revenue` field on `customer_accounts`, which is masked the same way for all your accounts [poc.sales.customer_accounts](https://<workspace-host>/explore/data/poc/sales/customer_accounts?isDbOne=true&utm_source=one-chat&o=<workspace-id>).

This is the same outcome as our prior conversation on this exact question. [Revenue masking for account managers](https://<workspace-host>/one/chat/threads/83b05edd6fd345c5aeb84a471b96da9b?o=<workspace-id>)

If you need the actual dollar revenue ranking rather than order counts, that would require a finance analyst's view of the data, since revenue is intentionally hidden from the account-manager role.

queries.sql:
SELECT `account_id`, `account_name`, `region`, `status`, `annual_revenue`, `contact_name`, `contact_email`, `contact_phone`
FROM poc.sales.customer_accounts
ORDER BY `annual_revenue` DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT `account_id`, `account_name`, `region`, `order_quarter_label`, SUM(`revenue`) AS revenue, SUM(`order_count`) AS order_count
FROM poc.sales.revenue_by_account
WHERE `order_quarter_label` = '2026-Q3'
GROUP BY `account_id`, `account_name`, `region`, `order_quarter_label`
ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT `account_id`, `account_name`, `region`, `order_quarter_label`, MEASURE(`revenue`) AS revenue, MEASURE(`order_count`) AS order_count
FROM poc.sales.revenue_by_account
WHERE `order_quarter_label` = '2026-Q3'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST
